fieldNotes.siteIdentification: Confirmed the WEST refrigerated complex (not the bare DC to the east) as PDC 3010. Address 1065 Fort Prince Blvd geocodes ROOFTOP to the east-facing office/employee parking of this complex; the building carries roof-mounted refrigeration banks and an ammonia tank farm consistent with a 725k sf perishable/cold DC, and matches the Sept-2025 grand-opening imagery.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Divided two-lane entrance driveway climbs ~350m from Fort Prince Blvd to a controlled checkpoint at the hilltop yard mouth (~34.9717,-82.1024).
fieldNotes.guardShack: z20 satellite shows a small booth structure in the median island where the inbound/outbound lanes split, with a service vehicle parked beside it. Classic guard-shack island position.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because a staffed guard shack is present.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Gate-to-dock approach and the long divided entrance driveway easily hold 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved interior yard between the gate and the dock faces provides ample post-gate holding.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided gate apron with unused paved width supports adding an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Multi-section building; primary dock bank runs along the south wall into the central yard plus an east-section dock bank. Estimated ~120 doors (50+ band) from overhead trailer rhythm; exact count low-confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Central paved yard holds organized rows of ~100+ parked trailers; a dedicated drop yard (50+).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Could not clearly confirm physically separate ship vs receive dock clusters from overhead; treated as single dock operation.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One large connected DC structure plus a separate maintenance/shop building at the south edge.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.streetView: Only the public-road intersection pano (EYDU-J3azbveHLrMwbAs9A, captured 2024-06) resolves; it looks N up the driveway toward the DC. No pano exists at the private hilltop gate (ZERO_RESULTS), so truckGate streetViewMeta omitted/false.
